

The cost of obtaining a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification can vary depending on the training provider and mode of delivery. [The training expenses can range from $200 to $2500](https://www.bing.com/aclk?ld=e8VgUcn8vQ8j2tty-U4DymDDVUCUwJ2Z34i4D1gB3I7LdBKhENO9NvBetiQNEAQYZX7CorvaW7ok6NiwGGkpw0vw_vhjC7SYM15eV9KbguAQYAZ_ZuvvKKx3vFC6I5wDLOwt8d7R2hV-mKEO7Jni13D4qGtoasBWyCTvx5i5WCrJOGa3NX&&rlid=43aed7f173dd1590eeacb28a5ae1bedd) [1](https://www.pmi.org/certifications/project-management-pmp). [The exam fee is $555 for non-PMI members and $405 for PMI members](https://www.bing.com/aclk?ld=e8VgUcn8vQ8j2tty-U4DymDDVUCUwJ2Z34i4D1gB3I7LdBKhENO9NvBetiQNEAQYZX7CorvaW7ok6NiwGGkpw0vw_vhjC7SYM15eV9KbguAQYAZ_ZuvvKKx3vFC6I5wDLOwt8d7R2hV-mKEO7Jni13D4qGtoasBWyCTvx5i5WCrJOGa3NX&&rlid=43aed7f173dd1590eeacb28a5ae1bedd) [1](https://www.pmi.org/certifications/project-management-pmp)[2](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/education/pmp-certification-cost/).

[The total cost of obtaining a PMP certification can be anywhere between $750 to $3000 3](https://www.pmbypm.com/pmp-certification-cost/). It’s worth noting that the cost of maintaining the certification is not included in this estimate. [To maintain the certification, a certain level of continuing education is required 2](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/education/pmp-certification-cost/).
